trigger: a spell's Grimoire and scroll text
before: defensive · you · foes need a 1 to hit, d6 rounds
after: defensive · you · foes hit you only on their die's top face (the top two faces if you insulted them), d6 rounds
why: The old text was a roll-under face count; foes roll high on a die that scales with their level, so it now names the top face, and the insulted top two, as the engine's override does.

trigger: a spell's Grimoire and scroll text

after: control · every foe · no more than their die's top three faces hit, and they do half, d4+1 rounds
why: "Hit on a 3" was the roll-under face count; Weaken caps every foe at three winning faces from the top of a die that scales with the foe's level.
